body:
Tick summary (pass_218):

Found and fixed a real bug while working Step 2.4 (dead recorders). A prior session (pass_157, Aug 25) found the slingshot recovery-mode trade counter was never being incremented, but concluded it only affected two log lines -- 'cosmetic, low priority.' Traced it further this time: that same counter is what ApplySlingshotAdjustments uses to decide how much risk to take during a drawdown-recovery episode (0.65x while under 8 trades, up to 0.90x once a recovery proves itself over 20+ trades at 65%+ WR). Since the counter never moved off zero, EVERY slingshot recovery this EA has ever run has been stuck at the most cautious 0.65x, with the higher, edge-proven settings structurally unreachable -- not a design choice, an accident. Fixed by routing the missing increments through the recovery function that already correctly tracks wins/losses, rather than a second, never-called one. Didn't touch the risk-multiplier values or the 0.90x ceiling, which were already reviewed and shipped -- this just lets the system reach settings that already existed. Compiled 0/0, deployed to all 3 locations, live run untouched throughout.

Flagging plainly since it's a live risk-sizing behavior change (demo account, no real money): next time a recovery mode activates and runs past ~8-20 trades, sizing can move for the first time. Full correction of pass_157's finding is in forge_ledger.json pass_218.

Live run: 8 of 9 regimes done under today's timeframe fix (mostly honest no-edge results, one kept tuned result at r2 Strong Bear on 6,090 trades), now on the last one (r9). Letting it finish rather than interrupting this close to the end -- once it's done, planning a deliberate restart with the historical-export flag on, to unblock the correlation-matrix and organism-lean measurements that infrastructure was built for earlier today.
